facts.rationale: Replaces overbroad repeat-suppression and boundedness language with literal behavior and verified external consumers.
facts.value: Shared launch initializer used after ordinary Jump, ItemScrew, and HammerJump motion entry. It initializes self velocity from existing horizontal momentum, stick input, character attributes, jump.x0 and a caller-supplied multiplier; clears jump.x4, stores the multiplier, writes the vertical-stick timer to 0xFE, and optionally requests audio. It does not choose a motion state. The timer write is not an unconditional repeat-input guarantee, and a symmetric speed-cap interpretation requires suitable finite inputs and a nonnegative cap.

evidence.why: All reads, arithmetic, comparisons, assignments and optional audio paths are present in the complete body.

facts.rationale: Records exact arithmetic order and intermediate overwrite instead of assuming all floats yield a conventional clamp or asserting an unverified compiled overlay.
facts.value: Clears jump.x4 and stores jump_mul. Scales old self_vel.x by ground_to_air_jump_momentum_multiplier * jump_mul, executes self_vel.y *= common x438, and sets self_vel.z to 0. It subsequently overwrites Y with jump_mul times hop_v_initial_velocity if jump.x0 is nonzero, otherwise jump_v_initial_velocity; the x438-scaled old Y does not contribute to final Y. Horizontal candidate is scaled old X plus jump_mul * (stickX * jump_h_initial_velocity). If ABS(candidate) > jump_h_max_velocity * jump_mul, it replaces the candidate with negative cap when candidate < 0, positive cap otherwise. Equality is unchanged. No scale/NaN/infinity validation occurs. It writes timer 0xFE; arg1 gates configured x10 audio and additionally non-null x197C gates SFX 0x11A. The compiled correspondence of jump.x0 to KneeBend's release latch is unresolved.

evidence.why: Local reset, selection, cap, timer and audio behavior.

facts.rationale: Preserves verified local state behavior while qualifying float assumptions and avoiding a compiled short-hop-overlay claim.
facts.value: Per invocation, resets jump.x4, records the multiplier, installs launch velocity using jump.x0 as the hop-attribute selector, and sets the stick-Y tilt timer to 0xFE. It neither changes motion state nor modifies jump.x0. Audio executes only when arg1 is true; the additional 0x11A request also requires x197C != NULL. Horizontal clamping is a strict ABS(candidate) > cap test and is only a conventional symmetric clamp for a valid nonnegative cap; exceptional or negative inputs are not rejected. Resetting x4 causes the next Jump_Phys_Inner invocation with the flag still clear to set it and skip ft_80084DB0.

evidence.why: Exact ordered chain, repeated x4 reads and physics gate.

facts.rationale: Replaces mixed inferred external names with exact canonical call ordering and identifies the precise phase-gate consumers without claiming a scheduler-wide frame delay.
facts.value: Tests in order ftCo_SpecialAir_CheckInput, ftCo_80095328(gobj,NULL), ftCo_800D7100, ftCo_800C3B10, ftCo_80099A58, ftCo_AttackAir_CheckItemThrowInput, ftCo_800D705C, jump.x4 && ftCo_800CEE70, jump.x4 && ftPe_8011BA54, and ftCo_800CB870. Each true result returns immediately. It then returns if jump.x4 is clear; otherwise it tests ftPe_8011BAD8. The flag is read at each guard, not snapshotted. The ftCo_800CB870 call is not x4-gated by this caller. Numeric external-handler gameplay aliases remain unproved here. The initializer clears x4, and the first inner physics invocation encountering it clear sets it and returns.
